claims.disproof_condition: 條件：PSI 之後的 10-Q／10-K／新聞稿寫出資料中心燃氣機組訂單取消、延後超過一年，或停止供應這一類機組；或買方的一手寫出改用別家機組取代它。核查頻率：每季（PSI 季報）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀 tech:gas_reciprocating_genset 供給側（本層讀圖寫成後）。
claims.statement: Supplier's own 10-K (Power Solutions International FY2025): designs and sells emission-certified spark-ignition and compression-ignition engines and power systems running on natural gas and other fuels; gensets are sold for prime power, microgrid and data center among other uses; largest customer was 20% of 2025 net sales. Self-report; the 10-K does not split data center revenue or name customers, and it does not say how much of its natural gas genset output goes to data centers.

source_doc.permission_basis: SEC EDGAR 公開申報（10-K）；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取 EDGAR 申報日 2026-03-02。
source_doc.title: Power Solutions International, Inc. Form 10-K（FY2025，2026-03-02）Item 1：天然氣等替代燃料的火花點火引擎與發電機組，終端市場含資料中心的主電源與備援；最大客戶占 2025 年營收 20%

sources.quote: Power Solutions International, Inc., incorporated under the laws of the state of Delaware in 2011, designs, engineers, manufactures, markets and sells a broad range of advanced, emission-certified engines and power systems that are powered by a wide variety of clean, alternative fuels, including natural gas, propane, and biofuels, as well as gasoline and diesel options, within the power systems, industrial and transportation end markets.

Power Systems Electric Power Generation (“Gensets”) Large Custom Genset Enclosures Mobile and Stationary Gensets for: Emergency Standby Rental Prime Power Demand Response Microgrid Oil & Gas Data Center

The Company sells engines and power systems, including both emission-certified compression ignition and spark-ignition internal combustion engines which are enabled by advanced controls to run on a wide variety of clean, alternative fuels, including natural gas, propane, and biofuels, as well as gasoline and diesel options, within the power systems, industrial and transportation end markets.
The Company’s largest customer represented 20% of consolidated net sales in 2025.
